name: spec-revision
title: Spec revision: correct stale claims, cut verbosity, split oversized docs
description: The .trellis/spec library has drifted from the code (missing symbols, retired modules, a duplicated section) and five documents have grown past 450 lines (hot-path.md 1655, udp-relay.md 1029, measurement-harness.md 607, windows-ndisapi.md 566, tcp-local-redirect.md 470). Revise every spec doc against the current source tree: fix outdated claims, delete redundant prose, and split anything still oversized into an indexed family of focused documents, then repair every index and cross-reference.
